summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of the AURUM TERMINAL XAU/USD dashboard. All 8 backend pytest tests pass (quote, candles, indicators, AI signal, signal history persistence, news, health, validation). Frontend dashboard loads with live data, all testids resolve, AI signal generates with BUY/72% confidence/entry/SL/TP/summary/reasoning, indicators populated, signal history table renders rows, news feed renders items, and timeframe switching works (verified 5m switch updated chart). Encountered TwelveData 429 rate limit on first attempt (free tier 8 req/min) — backend bubbles this up as raw 500 with no graceful handling; retried after 75s and all endpoints returned 200.

minor.issue: When TwelveData returns 429 (rate-limited, free tier = 8 req/min), httpx.raise_for_status() raises uncaught HTTPStatusError which surfaces as HTTP 500 to the client instead of a meaningful 429/503 or a stale-cache fallback. Frontend will show blank panels during quota windows.

action_items: (Low priority) Wrap TwelveData calls (td_get) in try/except for httpx.HTTPStatusError: on 429, either return last cached value (stale-if-error) or raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail='Market data temporarily rate-limited'). This will improve UX during quota windows.
(Optional) Increase cache TTLs slightly (quote 20-30s, candles 60s) to lower hit rate on TwelveData free tier.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py td_get() does not handle non-2xx responses gracefully; raise_for_status() leaks HTTPStatusError → 500. Catch and translate to proper HTTP errors or fallback to stale cache.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded from /api/signals/history projection — good.
AI JSON parsing is robust (handles ``` fences, finds outer braces) — good.
All caches are in-process dicts; OK for single-worker uvicorn but won't scale to multi-worker.
load_dotenv at top of server.py before reading env — correct order.
Pydantic models validate response shapes — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids resolved, chart + AI + indicators + history + news all populated, timeframe switching works)

seed_data_creation: AI signal endpoint call seeded ai_signals collection in MongoDB (verified via /api/signals/history returning 6+ entries).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses TwelveData free tier (8 req/min). If tests fail with HTTP 500, wait ~60-75s and retry — quota refresh fixes it. The AI endpoint is cached 120s per timeframe and the first call takes 5-10s. All data-testid attributes confirmed working: app-title, ticker-bar, ticker-symbol, ticker-price, timeframe-{1min|5min|15min|1h|4h|1day}-btn, refresh-btn, price-chart, ai-signal-card, ai-action-display, ai-entry, ai-sl, ai-tp, ai-summary, ai-reasoning, indicators-panel, ind-macd, ind-ema20, signal-history, news-feed, news-item-0.
rca of the issue: First test run failed with 500s on quote/candles/indicators/ai because the dashboard was actively polling (TickerBar 20s, plus chart/indicators/AI on load) and used up TwelveData's 8 req/min budget while pytest started. Backend's td_get() calls r.raise_for_status() on the 429, which propagates as an unhandled HTTPStatusError → FastAPI returns 500. After waiting ~75 seconds for quota reset, all 8 tests pass cleanly. Recommended mitigation: catch HTTPStatusError and return cached/stale data with a Warning header, or translate to 429 with Retry-After.
